ignoreValues.reason: Playwright spec: the literal '' appears inside an expect() failure-message string, not as markup. This test is what enforces the alt-text rule; no image ships from tests/.

Both hits are left rules on pull quotes: .hs-chapter__quote and a literal <blockquote> in .hs-legacy__copy. A left rule on a quotation is standard editorial typography, not a card side-tab accent — the rule targets cards. The rounded-card finding on .hs-region-card is deliberately NOT covered by this ignore.
